Name: (CP) Reasonable Fish Smokers
Author: rennieruins
Description:
[size=4]Reasonable Fish Smokers (Content Patcher Required)

[/size]Changes the crafting recipe for Fish Smokers from 
[code]﻿10 Hardwood, 1 Cave Jelly, 1 Sea Jelly, 1 River Jelly
[/code]to...
[code]﻿10 Coal, 10 Hardwood, 10 Seaweed, 3 Sea Jelly
[/code]
I know jellies can be hard to fish for, especially if you need to farm 1 of each type. With this mod, you can just focus on getting Sea Jellies to build the Fish Smoker. I tried to come up with a recipe that's not too easy and still require some effort to get. I'm open to any suggestions if anything should be changed. 

This is my first mod so I hope this can make someone's Stardew experience less stressful and more enjoyable!!! This mod is safe to use at any point in your save file and can be removed at any time.

Manifest.Description: Adjusts the crafting recipe for fish smokers.
